key_trends: Advertising-driven revenue growth across digital platforms (CTV, AVOD, social video) empowered by AI-powered targeting and hyper-personalisation
Generative AI accelerating content creation, localization, and efficiency across film, TV, games, and music
Streaming consolidation and password-sharing crackdowns lifting monetization, with live sports and events as growth catalysts
Social platforms expanding as entertainment destinations and ad giants, challenging traditional studios
Video gaming remains a major growth engine, outpacing traditional film/music revenues
Non-digital entertainment (live events, cinema) continues to contribute a sizable share of consumer spend despite streaming growth
reasoning: Industry forecasts from PwC (Global Entertainment & Media Outlook 2025-29, released July 24, 2025) indicate advertising as the fastest-growing revenue stream and AI-enabled innovations driving hyper-personalization and new monetization models. Deloitte's 2025 Digital Media Trends (March 25, 2025) highlight social video platforms as dominant ad spend drivers, while Nielsen (May 2025) shows AVOD/CTV adoption rising and streaming time increasing. Despite consumer budget constraints, these dynamics—AI-assisted production, ad-supported streaming, and social platforms expanding as entertainment hubs—support a positive overall trajectory for Media & Entertainment in 2025–2029.
